notes: Source of truth for captions and narration. id doubles as the audio file name (<id>.wav). 'text' is the on-screen caption; 'spoken' (optional) is the respelling sent to TTS. mode: any | vr | desktop.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Welcome to Nacre Bay. I'm Noor, the city engineer. A storm is coming, and it has broken our roads.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Nay-ker Bay. I'm Nuur, the city engineer. A storm is coming, and it has broken our roads.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: This model is the real city below us. Change one, and you change the other.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Reach for the bridge piece on the tray and squeeze the grip to pick it up.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Click and hold the bridge piece on the tray to pick it up.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Turn it until its ends meet the road, then let go over a glowing socket.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Press R to turn it until its ends meet the road, then let go over a glowing socket.
lines.spoken: Press R to turn it until its ends meet the road, then let go over a glowing socket.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: We only have one spare bridge. The west crossing is a long drive. The east one is shorter, but its harbour corner is broken too.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Nearly there. The harbour corner beside it is broken. Find the right piece and turn it to fit.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The road is through. That bridge is real at both scales now.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The shortcut is open! That bridge is real at both scales now.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Press X to fold down into the street.
lines.spoken: Press ex to fold down into the street.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Press Q to fold down into the street.
lines.spoken: Press cue to fold down into the street.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Move with the left stick, or hold A to aim a teleport and let go to jump. The courier car is just ahead.
lines.spoken: Move with the left stick, or hold eh to aim a teleport, and let go to jump. The courier car is just ahead.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Walk with W, A, S and D, and look around with the mouse. The courier car is just ahead.
lines.spoken: Walk with double-you, eh, ess and dee, and look around with the mouse. The courier car is just ahead.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Point at the car door and pull the trigger to climb in.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Press E at the car door to climb in.
lines.spoken: Press ee at the car door to climb in.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The left stick steers. The right trigger accelerates, and the left trigger brakes.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: W accelerates, S brakes and reverses, and A and D steer.
lines.spoken: Double-you accelerates, ess brakes and reverses, and eh and dee steer.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: You built that bridge with your own hands, and now you've driven across it. Nicely done.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The airfield substation is dark. Carry a power cell across your causeway and wake it up. The storm won't wait.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Grab the power cell from the dock and set it in the car's cradle.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Press E to pick up the power cell, then press E at the car to load it.
lines.spoken: Press ee to pick up the power cell, then press ee at the car to load it.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Follow the guide lights to the substation. Checkpoints will catch you if you leave the road.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Take the cell from the cradle and set it into the substation socket.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Take the cell from the cradle with E, and press E again at the substation socket.
lines.spoken: Take the cell from the cradle with ee, and press ee again at the substation socket.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Power is back on the island. Look at those lights!

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The passenger convoy is rolling out along your route.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: One flight left before the storm closes the sky. The terminal road is still broken, so the convoy can't reach the plane.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Use the airfield Fold Station. Press X.
lines.spoken: Use the airfield Fold Station. Press ex.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Use the airfield Fold Station. Press Q.
lines.spoken: Use the airfield Fold Station. Press cue.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Repair the terminal access link. Watch which way the roads meet.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Now restore the runway beacons. Point at each switch and pull the trigger.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Now restore the runway beacons. Press E at each switch.
lines.spoken: Now restore the runway beacons. Press ee at each switch.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The convoy is at the terminal. Passengers are boarding.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Everything is ready. Pull the departure lever in the tower.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Everything is ready. Press E on the departure lever in the tower.
lines.spoken: Everything is ready. Press ee on the departure lever in the tower.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Nacre tower: last flight, you are clear. Thank you, courier. Look at her go!
lines.spoken: Nay-ker tower. Last flight, you are clear. Thank you, courier. Look at her go!

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The city is safe. And it's still the one you built.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Welcome to Nacre Bay. One bridge, one power cell, one last flight. Let's go.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Nay-ker Bay. One bridge, one power cell, one last flight. Let's go.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Pull the beacon switch beside the substation to light the runway.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Press E on the beacon switch beside the substation to light the runway.
lines.spoken: Press ee on the beacon switch beside the substation to light the runway.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The runway is lit. Pull the departure lever.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The runway is lit. Press E on the departure lever.
lines.spoken: The runway is lit. Press ee on the departure lever.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The storm is close. Two minutes left.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Thirty seconds!

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: The storm reached us. That's alright. Let's try again from the last checkpoint.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Back at the checkpoint. You've got this.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Look for the sockets glowing teal on the model.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: No harm done. A fresh cell is waiting at the dock.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Let's put you back on the road.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Remote drive is on. You'll steer the car from right here.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Checkpoint.
